answer: The anchor graph is validated at intake and the garden frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and quartz anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 20 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 191 takes that multiplied out, plus 56 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
